<!-- What does this change, and why? One or two sentences is fine. -->

Refs #

- [ ] Tests pass, or the change needs none (docs only)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under `[Unreleased]` ending with the issue number, if users, operators or implementers will notice the change
- [ ] Release notes need **Nodes must be updated** (nodes on the previous version will reject what this produces)
- [ ] The docs it touches are updated (`docs/`) - and if it changes how something works, the chapter of [How it works](https://unseenet.org/guide/) that describes it (in unseenet-docs, `pages/guide/`)
- [ ] A protocol change has its UN-RFC draft or amendment in `rfc/`
- [ ] A change unseenet-gui must follow has an issue there
